newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi bourse index drops in bearish market.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi bourse index drops in bearish market.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange (NSE) 20-share index lost 1.92 points to stand at 3034.80 as prices eased further, reflecting the bearish sentiment of the market, brokers and bourse officials said.
Turnover was posted at 8.615 million shillings on 339,350 shares from 16,461 million shillings traded on 1,178,318 shares.
The market index has been steadily on a downward slide -- with occasional recoveries on the back of the three-day special lots board and prompt lots.
Foreign investors traded 90,300 shares of Rea Vipingo at 9.75 from 10.15, 13,400 shares of Firestone East Africa at 25 from 24.75 and 15,500 shares of Kenya Breweries at 48.50 from 48.
Within the last two days, an average of 180,000 shares of Rea Vipingo have been traded. Brokers said this was in anticipation of a company announcement expected soon with a proposed dividend of 1.70.

"Demand in the market has been boosted slightly by extra funds coming in from all those foreign investors who missed shares in the Kenya Commercial Bank public primary share issue, and are now investing elsewhere," a broker said.
"In the Industrials, Firestone East Africa attracts a lot of foreign investors, being one of the few locally controlled companies listed open to foreigners," a broker said.
Kenya Airways eased to 9.0 from 9.10, National Bank of Kenya closed at 14.30 from 14.20, while Carbacid slid to 104 from 115.
